answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because ledge only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, summit is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any glacier approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
